                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
Bulletin 
No. 77 
 
 
Events Date:  
30-Nov-2025 
 
 
Issued on: 
30-Nov-2025 
 
MONITORING PADDY RESIDUE BURNING IN INDIA USING 
SATELLITE REMOTE SENSING DURING 2025 
Prepared by: 
Consortium for Research on Agroecosystem Monitoring and Modeling from Space (CREAMS) 
Laboratory, 
Division of Agricultural Physics, ICAR – Indian Agricultural Research Institute, New Delhi – 110012 
https://creams.iari.res.in 

Highlights for 30-Nov-2025 
 The active fire events due to rice residue burning were monitored using satellite remote sensing, following the 
"Standard Protocol for Estimation of Crop Residue Burning Fire Events using Satellite Data". 
 Satellites detected 292 residue burning events in the six study States on 30-Nov-2025. 
 The state wise events detected on 30-Nov-2025 were 02 in Punjab, 03 in Haryana, 125 in UP, 00 in Delhi, 02 in 
Rajasthan and 160 in MP. 
 Total 33028 burning events were detected in the six states between 15-Sept-2025 and 30-Nov-2025, which are 
distributed as 5114, 662, 7290, 05, 2890 and 17067 in Punjab, Haryana, UP, Delhi, Rajasthan and MP, 
respectively.
